shortDescription: Resolve shift and overtime eligibility from frozen work rules and attested evidence, with capped deterministic minute calculations.
detailedDescription: ShiftFair supports participation, frozen work rules, attendance evidence, a distinct attestor, semantic adjudication, two-party challenges, second-round deliberation, and finalization. The production app reads a paged canonical case registry and supports wallet-validated actions with transaction receipt and canonical state reconciliation. Requested, provisional and final minutes are capped by contract rules.
problemSolved: Shift decisions combine written work rules, supervisor authorization, attendance evidence and capped overtime arithmetic.
whyThisRequiresGenLayer: Validators independently assess authorization and attendance semantics against frozen work rules. The contract then applies deterministic capped calculations; a deterministic workflow cannot decide whether the real-world record satisfies natural-language policy.
genuineSemanticConsensus: Leader and validators independently classify supervisor_authorized, attendance_matches_shift and evidence_sufficient in gl.vm.run_nondet_unsafe. The strict vector is checked; contract arithmetic caps policy/requested minutes and derives a provisional result. Challenges enter round two; disagreement cannot silently approve.

securityAndQualificationSummary: Automated adversarial, arithmetic-bound, state-machine, schema, address-compatibility, history-integrity and wallet E2E checks passed. A genuine Chromium signed transaction was reconciled against successful GenVM execution and canonical state. The synthetic full lifecycle finalized REVIEW_REQUIRED after both challenges. Production registry search/detail on deployment dpl_Dn2XLYLqNLMZpRJHSzhYMpeVQzZy verified the canonical terminal state, two challenges and two hash-linked history entries. The earlier 500-request/hour rejection is preserved; the latest registry and wallet browser checks passed after the quota reset.
reviewerInstructions: Open https://shiftfair-genlayer.vercel.app and connect a wallet on Studionet chain 61999. Review contracts/shiftfair.py, evidence/signed-browser-lifecycle.json, evidence/signed-browser-lifecycle-readback.json, evidence/signed-browser-lifecycle-resumption.json, evidence/browser-wallet-e2e.json, evidence/signed-browser-registry.json, and evidence/production-registry-retries.json. The BROWSER-LIFECYCLE-1792362857919-ShiftFair case finalized REVIEW_REQUIRED; its scenario is synthetic. The historic GLV4-shiftfair-39138804500 case also finalized REVIEW_REQUIRED. An earlier RPC quota failure is retained as evidence; the latest production registry check passed.
knownLimitationsAndExternalTrustAssumpti: Qualification source data were synthetic. An attestor signature proves control of the nominated wallet, not employee, supervisor or payroll identity, actual attendance, or document truth. The contract does not pay wages. No employment identity oracle is connected. Studionet RPC can temporarily rate-limit registry reads; the 2026-10-18 rate-limit response and 2026-10-19 successful production retry are both preserved. Case storage is append-only and unbounded over time.
